TABLE II. Comparison of the resistivities of MoN x thin films produced from different deposition methods, precursors, and reactants.

| Deposition method   | Precursor and reactant                          | Deposition temp. (°C)   | Resistivity ( μ Ω cm)   | Reference   |
|---------------------|-------------------------------------------------|-------------------------|-------------------------|-------------|
| PLD                 | Mo target and N 2 gas                           | 25 - 500                | 145 - 1500              | 13          |
| CVD                 | Mo(NCH 3 ) 2 ) 4 and NH 3                       | 200 - 400               | 10000                   |             |
| ALD                 | Mo(CO) 6 and NH 3 plasma                        | 180 - 230               | 3000 - 4500             | 12          |
